hook.text: Your body temperature rises. You start sweating. Sweat cools you down. Temperature stabilizes.

buildup.text: Balancing loops resist change and push toward equilibrium. They act as a thermostat for the system.

discovery.text: Predator-prey cycles balance ecosystems. Too many wolves eat all the deer. Fewer deer mean fewer wolves. Deer recover.

twist.text: Balancing loops explain why change is so hard.

climax.text: To change a system controlled by a balancing loop.

punchline.text: Systems resist change. Shift the target, not just the effort.

quiz.question: Why do balancing loops make change difficult?
options: They push the system back toward equilibrium, resisting deviation
They only work in mechanical systems
